items.title: Sabre Wants to Be the Transaction Engine Behind AI Travel Bookings
items.why: If AI agents become the booking front door, transaction infrastructure like Sabre becomes a key integration point for card travel benefits.
items.summary_ai: Sabre is positioning itself as the transaction layer behind AI-driven travel bookings, even when AI platforms own the customer relationship.
items.take: If AI agents become the booking front door, transaction infrastructure like Sabre becomes a key integration point for card travel benefits.
